15.   ORDINANCE –2nd READING – Annexing to the City of Cheyenne, Wyoming, various
      tracts of land completely surrounded by current City limits situate in western and
      southern Cheyenne, generally located east of I-25, south of the intersection of Westland
      Road and Missile Drive, north of West and East Allison Road, and east of and adjacent to
      North College Drive. (SPONSOR – DR. EMMONS)

ACTION:

16.   ORDINANCE –2nd READING – Amending the Official Zoning Map of the City of
      Cheyenne, establishing the zoning classifications of AG – Agricultural, MR – Medium-
      Density Residential, CB – Community Business, and LI – Light Industrial, for land
      annexed to the City of Cheyenne generally located east of I-25, south of the intersection
      of Westland Road and Missile Drive, north of West and East Allison Road, and east of
      and adjacent to North College Drive. (SPONSOR – DR. EMMONS)

ACTION:

17.   RESOLUTION – Expressing the support of the Governing Body for the inclusion of
      Laramie County Property ID Number 14663133500500 in the Downtown Development
      District. (SPONSOR – MR. WHITE)

ACTION:

18.   RESOLUTION – Authorizing the Mayor and City Clerk to sign a final plat for Village
      Cooperative, City of Cheyenne, Laramie County, Wyoming (located north of Prairie
      Avenue, east of Powderhouse Road, west of Rue Terre, and south of Storey Boulevard).
      (SPONSOR – DR. EMMONS)
